concepts.learning_objective: Distinguish elastic from plastic behaviour of bodies under deforming forces.
Define stress and the longitudinal, shearing and volume strains and compute simple strains.

topics.title: Hooke's law and the stress-strain curve

concepts.learning_objective: State Hooke's law and the region of the stress-strain curve in which it holds.
Interpret the elastic limit, yield point, permanent set and fracture on a stress-strain curve.
Classify materials as ductile, brittle or elastomers from their stress-strain behaviour.
Define Young's modulus and identify the states of matter for which it is meaningful.
Use F/A = Y(Delta L/L) to calculate and compare extensions of wires.
Define the shear modulus and use it to find the displacement under a tangential force.
Define the bulk modulus and calculate the fractional change in volume under hydraulic pressure.

topics.title: Poisson's ratio and elastic potential energy

concepts.learning_objective: Define Poisson's ratio and calculate it from lateral and longitudinal strains.
Calculate the elastic potential energy stored in a stretched wire.

topics.title: Applications of elastic behaviour of materials

concepts.learning_objective: Estimate the minimum cross-section of a crane rope from the yield strength.
Use the sag relation for a centrally loaded beam to explain beam design.
Estimate the maximum height of a mountain from the elastic limit of rock.
